news.title: Is Clarity's delay a blessing in disguise?: State of Crypto
news.summary: The crypto industry is angry and disappointed that the Senate is not holding a procedural vote on the Clarity Act this month, but that isn't the worst possible outcome.

news.title: Hyperliquid’s RWA perps boom is eating into the revenue that backs HYPE
news.summary: Revenue has fallen four quarters running while open interest hit a record high. The gap is a fee-sharing program that hands half the platform's volume to outside builders.

news.title: Bitcoin investors pour $853 million into spot ETFs. BlackRock’s IBIT claims the bulk
news.summary: Bitcoin ETFs recorded $853.54 million in net inflows last week, the strongest since mid-April, with BlackRock’s IBIT taking the bulk.
